sheets.title: A claim link on a locked device — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The link opens on the front door either way: sign-in and guest first, nothing in front of them (ADR 0090). The difference is the address the first painted frame had.
sheets.before: first render address …/claim#token=osc_clm_… — the bearer in the bar
sheets.after: first render address …/claim — the bearer left at boot

sheets.title: After Continue as guest — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Before, /claim on a guest vault was no route at all. After, the claim is presented once (the stand-in answered it) and shown for review; the consent code is the only field.
sheets.before: empty shell, no h1, focus on body, bearer still in the address
sheets.after: h1 Accept a claim; Kind · Items 2 · Manifest; focus on Consent code (352×44, focus-visible); .go 44×44

sheets.title: Accepted — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The answer is a StatusMark; the panel that says so takes the focus, because the key that answered is gone.
sheets.after: 1 ok mark (Claim accepted), 0 .note boxes, focus on the Claim accepted panel

sheets.title: A drop link where Drops are off (the default) — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Drops are optional. The dispatcher loads none of their code: it says so with a mark and in the tray.
sheets.before: empty shell; bearer and key in the address
sheets.after: h1 Open a drop, Drop not opened + 1 warn mark, tray notice; address …/claim

sheets.title: The same link, Sharing switched on — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: With drops approved, the route draws the opener sharing.drops contributed. Before, it was the drops module's own route, drawn on a locked device with the key still in the address.
sheets.before: unframed Open a drop on the locked screen; bearer and key in the address; focus on body
sheets.after: framed behind the guest unlock; focus on One-time code (352×44, focus-visible); address …/claim

sheets.title: Opened — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The same decryption either way: the payload was sealed under the link's key and opened here.
sheets.after: payload shown with 1 ok mark (Drop opened); 0 .note boxes
